summary: Incremental projection no longer registers an operation from a claim a repair replaced, so its operations rows match a full replay's after a replicated repair of a claim the node already held

replay.detail: No replay at upgrade. A store whose incremental pass already re-registered such a row keeps it until its next full replay or a repair touching that operation, which drops it.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest rule change. The operations rows feed graph_digest; this removes a cause of graph-digest disagreement between members holding the same claims.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change.
